contract: For alpha>-1, beta>0, p>0 the stated generalized-gamma radial density integrates to one; alpha=T-1,p=2,beta=1/(2*sigma^2) recovers Gaussian radial MSE T*sigma^2; alpha=T-1,p=1,beta=1/theta recovers ell2-Laplace radial MSE theta^2*T*(T+1).
failure_behavior: The cumulative verifier exits nonzero if any identity exceeds its stated tolerance.
